SELECT announcement_id, subject, body, user_id, email FROM (
SELECT a.announcement_id AS announcement_id, a.title AS subject, a.body AS body, u.user_id AS user_id, u.email AS email FROM app.announcement a JOIN app.announcement_region ar ON ar.announcement_id = a.announcement_id JOIN app.zip_code_master z ON (ar.city_code IS NOT NULL AND z.city_code = ar.city_code) OR (ar.city_code IS NULL AND z.prefecture_code = ar.prefecture_code) JOIN app.app_user u ON u.zip_code = z.zip_code WHERE a.status = '1' AND u.email IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT a.announcement_id AS announcement_id, a.title AS subject, a.body AS body, u.user_id AS user_id, u.email AS email FROM app.announcement a JOIN app.announcement_region ar ON ar.announcement_id = a.announcement_id JOIN app.zip_code_master z ON (ar.city_code IS NOT NULL AND z.city_code = ar.city_code) OR (ar.city_code IS NULL AND z.prefecture_code = ar.prefecture_code) JOIN app.app_user family_user ON family_user.zip_code = z.zip_code JOIN app.family_relation fr ON fr.family_user_id = family_user.user_id JOIN app.app_user u ON u.user_id = fr.user_id AND u.zip_code IS NULL WHERE a.status = '1' AND u.email IS NOT NULL ) notify_target ORDER BY announcement_id, user_id
